name: Southwest Rapid Rewards® Plus Credit Card

localized_names.en: Southwest Rapid Rewards® Plus Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs; see current Chase pricing and terms for exact rates.

rewards.redemption_notes: Rapid Rewards points are transferred to Southwest Airlines after each billing cycle.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Primary Cardmember and up to eight passengers traveling on the same reservation can each receive their first standard checked bag free on eligible Southwest-operated flights.

benefits.title: Standard seat selection within 48 hours
benefits.description: Primary Cardmembers may select a Standard seat within 48 hours prior to departure, when available, for themselves and up to eight additional passengers on the same reservation.

benefits.title: 3,000 anniversary points
benefits.description: Receive 3,000 bonus points each account anniversary year.

benefits.title: 10% annual flight discount
benefits.description: Receive a 10% promotion code each account anniversary year for eligible Southwest flight purchases, excluding Basic fares.

benefits.title: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost
benefits.description: Earn one 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost each calendar year.

benefits.title: Group 5 boarding benefit
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to eight additional passengers on the same reservation may board with Group 5 on eligible Southwest-operated flights.

benefits.title: 25% back on inflight purchases
benefits.description: Receive 25% back as a statement credit on eligible Southwest Airlines inflight purchases for drinks and WiFi.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on baggage during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses essential purchases up to $100 per day for up to 3 days when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer's warranties of three years or less by an additional year.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days from purchase, up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Complimentary DashPass for 12 months when activated by 2027-12-31, plus up to $10 off quarterly on eligible non-restaurant DoorDash orders through 2027-12-31.

benefits.title: Instacart+ and monthly Instacart credit
benefits.description: Three months of complimentary Instacart+ when activated by 2027-12-31, plus one $10 monthly Instacart credit while eligible terms are met.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First standard checked bag free for the primary Cardmember and up to eight passengers on the same reservation on eligible Southwest-operated flights.
other: Standard seat selection within 48 hours when available
10% annual Southwest flight discount promotion code

notes: Chase pricing terms state applicants may receive a Signature or Platinum card with different costs and/or benefits; offer details and APRs can change.
